minor.issue: LLM extractor's secondary analyze_interaction() logs 'No LLM API key configured' and falls through to fallback scorer (qa_score=83 static). Root cause: llm_service._make_chat() does not see EMERGENT_LLM_KEY the way the bulk extractor does (extractor uses LlmChat directly, analyzer uses a different wrapper). Not demo-blocking — each chunk still gets scored and rep/customer names are extracted correctly — but all bulk interactions will carry the same fallback qa_score instead of a genuine LLM score. Suggest plumbing EMERGENT_LLM_KEY into _make_chat() or switching analyze_interaction() to the same LlmChat pattern used in _infer_rep_and_customer().

ui_bugs.issue: End key navigates to index 5 instead of 6 (last card). Root cause: target = offsetTop + (clamped/total)*scrollable + 4 — with total=7 and clamped=6 this lands at 6/7≈85.7% of scrollable which still rounds to floor(0.857*7)=6 in theory, but in practice the sticky-container boundaries + smooth-scroll overshoot leave active at 5. ArrowRight still reaches 6 by stepping through, so user-visible impact is limited to the End key and the far-right dot click might also miss. Fix: use (clamped/(total-1)) instead of (clamped/total), OR compute progress ceiling when clamped==total-1.

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED during testing — server.py _check_brute_force: compared tz-aware `now` against tz-naive `locked_until` from MongoDB → threw TypeError → FastAPI returned 500 instead of 429. This was THE bug behind iter-12/14/18 carry-over 'brute force broken behind K8s' report. Root cause was NOT the XFF refactor — it was MongoDB's BSON datetime stripping tzinfo on round-trip. Applied: if locked_until.tzinfo is None: locked_until = locked_until.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc). Now 6th login → 429 cleanly.

server.py _run_bulk: errors[] is always empty in the 2-file smoke, but the fallback-scorer path silently logs 'No LLM API key configured' — consider surfacing the fallback count in the response (e.g. fallback_scored: N) so UI can show a warning when real scoring degraded.
server.py _infer_rep_and_customer prompt is well-structured but sends transcript[:6000] — for long voice calls (30k chars) the middle/end is lost. Consider head+tail slicing or summarize-first.

Landing.jsx PlatformStack: active-index computation (floor(progress*total)) and goToCard target ((clamped/total)*scrollable) use inconsistent math — the forward computation uses total but the inverse should use (total-1) to exactly hit the last card. Off-by-one visible via End key.

rca of the issue: BUG 1 — brute-force returning 500 instead of 429: MongoDB BSON strips tzinfo on datetime round-trip, so `rec['locked_until'] > datetime.now(timezone.utc)` raised 'can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes' → FastAPI 500. The X-Forwarded-For header extraction (the actual iter-20 ask) was already working correctly — the bug was in the comparator. Reproduction: 6 POSTs to /api/auth/login with wrong password and same X-Forwarded-For → 6th returned 500 (now 429). Mitigation applied: tz-coerce when reading locked_until back from Mongo. BUG 2 — End-key off-by-one: goToCard(6) scrolls to 6/7 of scrollable height, but active-index math floors at 5 due to sticky-container boundary. Non-blocking because ArrowRight steps through 0→1→…→6 correctly and the dot click on platform-dot-6 would also miss by the same amount.
